preconditions.description: The graph has at least 2 vertices and at least n-1 edges (connected), with no more than 200,000 edges.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and ai != bi and 1 <= ci <= 10**4 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge (ai, bi) connects distinct vertices within bounds, and each flow volume ci is between 1 and 10,000.
The input contains exactly m edges, each represented as a tuple (ai, bi, ci).

preconditions.expression: all(ai != bi for ai, bi, _ in edges)
preconditions.description: No edge connects a vertex to itself.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m integers, one for each input edge.

postconditions.expression: all(di in {0, 1} for di in output_directions)
postconditions.description: Each output direction di is either 0 (ai → bi) or 1 (bi → ai).

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n and v != 1 and v != n and sum(ci for (u, v, ci) in edges if (u == v and di == 0) or (v == u and di == 1)) == sum(ci for (u, v, ci) in edges if (v == v and di == 0) or (u == v and di == 1)) for v in range(2, n))
postconditions.description: For every intermediate vertex v (1 < v < n), the sum of incoming flow equals the sum of outgoing flow.

postconditions.expression: sum(ci for (u, v, ci) in edges if (u == 1 and di == 0) or (v == 1 and di == 1)) == sum(ci for (u, v, ci) in edges if (u == n and di == 1) or (v == n and di == 0))
postconditions.description: The total flow out of the source (vertex 1) equals the total flow into the sink (vertex n).

postconditions.expression: not any((u == v and di == 0) or (v == u and di == 1) for (u, v, _), di in zip(edges, output_directions) if u == v)
postconditions.description: No directed edge forms a self-loop (though this is already implied by P4).

postconditions.expression: not any((u == v and di == 0) or (v == u and di == 1) for (u, v, _), di in zip(edges, output_directions) if u == v)
postconditions.description: The directed graph has no cycles (implied by the problem's guarantee of a solution and the acyclic orientation requirement).
